artifacts.summary: Six sequential phases (10 h): fresh-build probe re-establishment; a new PlusSlicedCertificate/Examples.lean exhibiting the sliced and sharing interesting witnesses with every generated surface regenerated and C2 pins; C36 non-vacuity + coverage-limit guard (certificate-witness-inventory.txt, --no-build structural half, RUN_BUILD evaluative half); C37 clause-shape check (clause-shape-allowlist.txt seeded from the 30-row re-derived table, anchor re-verification); time-boxed Tier-2 box-carrying sliced witnesses; docs and final gate.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic, adding any new .lean module under FormalSystem/ touches four generated or aggregated surfaces that the invariant gate checks byte-for-byte: the subtree aggregator import list, FormalSystem.lean (regenerated only via `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem`, C33), the README.md `<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory -->` block (regenerated via `check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory`, live-file count), and typst/generated/status.typ (`scripts/typst-status-counts.sh`, needs a built library; checked by typst-sync-check.sh). A plan that lists only the new module under-declares file_scope and the phase fails C33/INV/typst-sync between substeps -- declare all four and treat the module landing as an atomic-batch phase.
